heading: Independent grievance review
memberIntro: Ask for an independent review of a closed grievance within 30 days of closure. You may request one review per grievance.
closedOnly: Independent review can be requested only after the grievance is closed and within 30 days of closure.
reason: Why you disagree with the resolution
pending: Your review is awaiting a decision.
fresh: A fresh decision has been directed to the original office.
queueIntro: Review grievances from other offices in your zone. Decide by the date shown.
failed: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
